note: Upstream PHP (aternosorg/thanos) is a *reference* implementation. Vectors it cannot run (feature absent) are 'not_applicable'; vectors where it demonstrably behaves differently are 'expected_failures' and must have a row in spec/upstream-divergences.md. Anything else that differs is a real signal: either the spec needs to be aligned with upstream, or upstream is wrong — decide and record it, do not silence it here.

not_applicable.reason: upstream has no merge command (WOS-8 is project-specific)
upstream has no --force / cleans no output directory

expected_failures.reason: upstream reads the packed long high-32 as x (axis swap) — see upstream-divergences.md
upstream does a raw byte-prefix scan and picks the nested decoy tag
upstream copies session.lock to the output
upstream aborts the whole run on a corrupt region instead of preserving it
upstream throws on an unreadable chunk and aborts
upstream throws UnsupportedFeatureException for CUSTOM compression
upstream needs the PHP lz4 extension; the harness installs only zlib
